game.name: There Is No Game
game.rules:
## Few general rules for this non game :

- Top 10 runs requires to be on youtube for retiming purposes.
- Autoclicker / Drag clicking / Scroll clicking are not allowed.
- You can only use left/right click to click, no keyboard input.
- Mouse and trackpads only for the Web and Steam versions. This means touchscreen and tablet are not allowed.
- Mobile version means the apps you can find on Play Store / App Store. You are not allowed to play the web version on your mobile.
- Please also read the Category Rules for categories specific rules.

relatedGames.name: There Is No Game Category Extensions
relatedGames.rules:
# Few general rules for this non game :

- All runs are Glitchless and all glitches are banned unless stated otherwise in the Sub Category Rules.
- No Emulators
- No cheating of any kind. (Autoclickers, Macros, Splicing, Speeding it up, etc.)
- Video Proof is REQUIRED to submit a run.
- Contact us on Discord if you have any questions or concerns.

categories.name: Web
categories.rules:
- **Beat the game** (the non game).

- **Start the timer** when you choose your language, **stop it** when you choose "yes" or "no" at the end dialog.
- **For submitting a sub 4:30 run**, please make sure to have a video proof. All runs with a higher time don't need video proof. (ONLY FOR THE WEB VERSION)

- **Use NEWGROUNDS or SCIRRA** because some sites, such as CoolMathGames, change the opening cutscene and invalidate the run. If you wish to submit a run made on CoolMathGames, you can submit it here https://www.speedrun.com/tingce?h=Web_Version-coolmath&x=q25e40y2-ql673gw8.5lez7pkl

categories.rules:

- **Start the timer** when you choose your language, **stop it** when you choose "yes" or "no" at the end dialog.

- **All runs requires a video for verification.**

categories.name: Polished Mobile
categories.rules:

- **Start the timer** when you choose your language, **stop it** when you choose "yes" or "no" at the end dialog.

categories.name: Old Mobile
categories.rules:
- **Beat the game** (the non game).
- **Start the timer** when you choose your language, **stop it** when you choose "yes" or "no" at the end dialog.
- **THIS OLD VERSION OF THE GAME ISN'T AVAILABLE ON THE STORE ANYMORE!** If you want to play/speedrun it, there is a link to an unofficial download in Sources.
- **All glitches are not allowed** (because glitch% exclusive glitches are impossible to perform here).
- **For submitting a sub 5:00 run**, please make sure to have a video proof. All runs with a higher time don't need video proof.

- **Beat the game** (the non game) **While getting all the achievements** (INCLUDING THE 2 ENDINGS).
- **Start the timer** when you choose your language, **stop it** when you choose "yes" or "no" at the end of your 2nd run.
- **Achievements don't have to show**, just do the requirements to make them work normally.
- **All runs require a video for verification.**

categories.name: Combined Times
categories.rules:
# This leaderboard is only for runners with 4 out of 4 verified (with video proof) glitchless runs for WEB, STEAM, POLISHED MOBILE and OLD MOBILE.

- **To submit your time**, you need to link any of your runs in the video slot and link all 4 runs in the description.
- **You can provide an approximation** if you don't want to calculate it yourself. Moderators will calculate the time themselves.

levels.name: Nothing in This Title
levels.rules:
- **Time starts** when you click the O in There is no Game title for the first time and ends when you insert the letters in the 'There is no' rectangle, spelling 'game'.
- **No any% exclusive tricks/glitches allowed.**
- **Video Proof is mandatory** for submission.

levels.name: Ball Minigame
levels.rules:
- **Time starts** when you first touch the bar at the minigame and ends when the last brick is broken.
- **Video Proof is mandatory** for submission.

levels.name: Grow a Tree
levels.rules:
- **Time starts** when you enter the main screen with your trophy(or Metal case for steam ver.), while 'goat' and 'tree' must not be spelled in the 'There is no' rectangle yet. **The timer ends** when after freeing the goat with the key.
- **No any% exclusive tricks/glitches allowed.**
- **Video Proof is mandatory** for submission.
